agreement_discounts_kind_ck.name: agreement_discounts_kind_ck
agreement_discounts_kind_ck.value:
(kind = 'percentage' AND percentage_bps BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND fixed_amount_minor IS NULL)
       OR (kind = 'fixed' AND fixed_amount_minor > 0 AND percentage_bps IS NULL)

payments_allocation_ck.name: payments_allocation_ck
payments_allocation_ck.value: allocated_minor >= 0 AND refunded_minor >= 0 AND allocated_minor + refunded_minor <= amount_minor

payments_reversal_ck.name: payments_reversal_ck
payments_reversal_ck.value:
(status = 'completed' AND reversed_at IS NULL)
       OR (status = 'reversed' AND reversed_at IS NOT NULL AND reversal_reason IS NOT NULL AND allocated_minor = 0)

receivables_installment_ck.name: receivables_installment_ck
receivables_installment_ck.value: kind <> 'installment' OR (payment_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND sequence_no IS NOT NULL)

receivables_status_consistency_ck.name: receivables_status_consistency_ck
receivables_status_consistency_ck.value:
(status = 'cancelled' AND allocated_minor = 0)
       OR (status = 'paid' AND allocated_minor = amount_minor)
       OR (status = 'open' AND allocated_minor < amount_minor)
